education.description: Currently a 3rd year CompSci student. On the Dean’s Honours List Western Engineering AutoPilot Club (Mapping Team)

posts.text: We didn't win the NVIDIAxSPARK Hackathon, but we definitely built something cool. We built UrbanForge. Which uses Toronto’s open data to analyze the impact of any building regarding to the economy (increase in jobs or electric bills), environment (air pollution, water pollution, trees removed), and transit impact (increase/decrease in traffic congestion). Couldn’t do this without my awesomely cool team: Ahmed Naeem, Benjamin Namayandeh, Rehan Sethi, Wali Mian, Yusuf Bishi CISSP. Thanks Kiana S.,

We finished. After showing up 20 hours late, surviving on no sleep, and building an AI scarecrow that screams at raccoons. We’re about to present. HackCanada, it's been a ride. Final results coming soon. 👀 Made with Stan #HackCanada #Hackathon #BuildInPublic

It's 5am and I have no idea what we birthed. We built an AI scarecrow at HackCanada. Yes, you read that right. It uses computer vision to tell the difference between farm animals and threats. Coyotes, raccoons, thieves - it spots them and scares them off. Crops and livestock stay protected. The goal? A full AI-powered security system for farms. I'm 20 hours late to HackCanada. Had a cooked midterm this morning. Bus came 2 hours late. Everything that could go wrong, did. But now we’re here at HackCanada. 16 hours left. The theme is to build solutions for Canadian issues. We’re building something to help Canadian farms. Can't wait to meet other builders and ship something real.
